rationale: Existing global G08 already owns evidence round-trip and immutable-source requirements, while G11 owns registered preflight, revision-bounded one-shot attempts, and fail-closed completion. Revision-scoped rejected artifacts, compact parent projections, structured invocation diagnostics, and Rescue-specific terminal states remain implementation contracts of the experimental Memory Wuxian summary-v2 capability, so this round does not propose another global rule.
